# 🐞 bug report

### Affected Package
<!-- Can you pin-point one or more @angular/* packages as the source of the bug? -->
<!-- ✍️edit: --> The issue is caused by package @angular/localize^10.1.0-next.7


### Description

<!-- ✍️--> In ts code I use i18n:
``` typescript
$localize`hello {world}`
```
then I extract xlf and translate it:
``` xml
<trans-unit id="1122334455667788999" datatype="html">
  <source>hello {world}</source>
  <context-group purpose="location">
    <context context-type="sourcefile">myapp.js</context>
    <context context-type="linenumber">1234</context>
  </context-group>
<target xml:lang="es">hola {mundo}</target>
</trans-unit>
```

then I run `localize-translate` and get `undefined` error:
```
npx localize-translate -r scripts -s myapp.js -t strings.es.xlf -o es
```


## 🔥 Exception or Error
```
undefined
```


## 🌍  Your Environment

**Angular Version:**
```
10.1.0-next.7
```

it was not displayed. Just the error message.

Now the position (line and column) and some context is displayed
along with the error messages.

Fixes #38377
